seo.title: PachA Luz Chinese Lantern Festival
seo.description: Step into an illuminated wonderland of monumental lanterns, living traditions, food and live performances for an unforgettable festival night.
seo.keywords: Chinese lantern festival,light festival,cultural festival,Madrid events,family activities,Lunar New Year

hero.eyebrow: A luminous world from the East
hero.title: A thousand lights. One magical night.
hero.subtitle: Walk through a world where tradition meets imagination and discover the warmth and wonder of Chinese lantern art.

about.title: Light speaks in stories thousands of years old
about.body: PachA Luz is more than a lantern show. Master artisans shape silk, steel and countless points of light into a walkable world of myths, nature and contemporary imagination—for families, friends and everyone who still believes in wonder.

experience.title: A new world around every corner

items.title: Lantern craft
items.body: Traditional makers shape, cover and paint every piece by hand, bringing an ancient art brilliantly back to life.

items.title: Live shows
items.body: Lion dance, traditional music and contemporary performance bring the festival's pulse within reach.

items.title: Flavours of Asia
items.body: From steaming street food to festive sweets, complete the cultural journey one taste at a time.

gallery.title: A first look into the beautifully unreal
gallery.description: Every gallery is generated from its own image folder. Operators can add or remove images without touching page code.
